name: hex
description: Connect Hex to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Hex MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Hex to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with data projects and analysis using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Hex workspace.
Find anything in Hex that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review data projects and analysis in Hex.
